name: Unicons Monochrome
about: Unicons Monochrome is a free, open-source icon set with 298 icons designed by Iconscout. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under Apache 2.0.

faqs.q: Are Unicons Monochrome free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 298 Unicons Monochrome are open source under the Apache 2.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the Apache 2.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Unicons Monochrome in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Unicons Monochrome are there?
faqs.a: There are 298 icons in the Unicons Monochrome set, designed by Iconscout. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Unicons Monochrome?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Unicons Monochrome available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
